full_judgment: 2. Short facts, necessary for disposal of this Rule, is that, the present opposite party No.1 as pre-emptor filed present pre-emption case impleading the present petitioner and other proforma opposite parties that the pre-emptor Hatem Ali Sarder, is a co-sharer by inheritance in the case Khatian and pre-emptor was in exclusive possession of the case land by way of oral exchange, the opposite party No.2 the owner of the suit land secretly sold the land to the stranger opposite party No. 1 by a registered deed dated 25.03.1997 and after obtaining certified copy of the deed filed this pre-emption case depositing the consideration money with statutory compensation.
